info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of consumer investment services, enabling businesses to update specific investment details based on unique parameters. By utilizing the provided endpoint, organizations can modify investment records for consumers, ensuring that the most accurate and current data is maintained. Typical users include financial institutions and investment platforms looking to enhance their service offerings and improve consumer satisfaction. The API allows for targeted updates, contributing to optimal investment management and personalized consumer experiences.
